scientific.integrity: The sign condition follows directly from the defining IMTL-G scale-transformation denominator. An exact linearly independent three-gradient construction verifies that a negative source-form coefficient can occur and that the normalized equal-projection system becomes singular before reversing orientation. The date records the ICLR 2021 full-paper submission date of the public under-review source; no earlier paper-specific public full-text date was verified.
limitations: Instantaneous gradient-aggregation result rather than a full training-trajectory theorem.
The mechanism uses the source coefficient-sum normalization.
No empirical frequency is claimed for negative IMTL-G coefficients.
The later Jacobian-descent paper already covers general non-linearity under scaling; the new claim is the exact sign threshold and full-rank reversal.

title: Full-rank IMTL-G has a sharp positive-rescaling reversal threshold
